name: edge-cache-purge-console
title: Edge Cache Purge Console
description: A global CDN cache invalidator with URL path targeting, tag-based purging, and execution verification logs.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Compact
Shape: Rounded
Motion: None
Typography: Monospace
Color: Accent Only

## Rules

- Cache Invalidation Path Purge: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
